hero.intro: I’m a software engineer based in Managua, Nicaragua, with 3+ years of experience building web applications. My work spans interfaces, backend services, and cloud technologies, including an employee self-service platform for payroll documents, leave requests, and internal workflows.

about.title: About me
about.p1: I’m a systems engineer working in software development, with experience across frontend, backend, and cloud technologies. My work includes employee self-service software, where interfaces and services support specific tasks such as downloading payroll documents, requesting leave, and managing internal information.
about.p2: My main tools include TypeScript, Vue.js, Node.js, and PostgreSQL, alongside AWS, Docker, and Kubernetes. I’m looking for a software engineering role where I can contribute to useful products and continue developing my skills in cloud infrastructure and automation.

services.title: Ways I can help
services.intro: Alongside my search for a software engineering role, I’m open to discussing focused development projects. These are the areas where my current experience can contribute.

webapps.title: Business web applications
webapps.text: Build or extend internal tools, dashboards, and self-service applications for specific business workflows, using Vue.js, TypeScript, and a Node.js backend.

backend.title: Backend services & integrations
backend.text: Develop APIs and backend features, connect application components, and work with PostgreSQL to support the data behind business processes.

cloud.title: Cloud deployment & containers
cloud.text: Help prepare and deploy web applications using AWS and container-based tooling, with the scope defined around the application’s requirements.

automation.title: Workflow automation
automation.text: Identify repetitive steps in an existing process and build focused tools or integrations to reduce manual handling.

contactSection.title: Let’s talk about your team or project.
contactSection.intro: If you’re hiring a software engineer, I’d like to hear what your team is building and where I could contribute. For project work, tell me about the workflow you want to improve, the system you already have, and the scope you have in mind.
